name: galileo-gallery

scripts.verify:g02-renderer: npm run build && npm run prepare:electron && REEL_USER_DATA_DIR=./artifacts/g02-runtime REEL_G02_RENDERER_OUTPUT=./artifacts/g02 electron . && node scripts/verify-g02-renderer-artifacts.cjs ./artifacts/g02
scripts.verify:g08-renderer: npm run build && npm run prepare:electron && node scripts/run-g08-renderer.cjs
scripts.package:mac: npm run prepare:ffmpeg && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir --publish never
scripts.package:windows: npm run prepare:ffmpeg && npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run prepare:ffmpeg && npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux:g03: npm run prepare:ffmpeg && npm run build && node scripts/write-build-identity.cjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.g03.json --linux dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare:ffmpeg && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
